doc.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Recording for Gus Statiras's Progressive label
summary: He recorded early sessions for the Progressive label in the early 1950s, not knowing how the connection was made.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Another gentleman who had a label was Gus DeTerris. And he brought, either he brought, or Eddie Bert somehow found you, that was one of the early recordings.
Yeah, I wasn’t partied to that, you understand, I wasn’t present as to who said what to whom. As far as I know, I recorded it for Gus Deterris, for a label called…
Well, yeah it was called Progressive.
Yeah, Progressive was the name on the bill, “Progressive Label.” And that’s what… we started recording groups
It would have to be in there somewhere, I can’t remember. It would be in the ‘50’s, early 50’s.
